subject.title: fix(polls): add default maximum poll option count

question: For Matrix polls with more than 20 requested options, should OpenClaw truncate to the first 20 options, reject the send, or retain the current passthrough behavior?
rationale: MSC3381 may constrain event shape, but the choice between silently dropping options, failing the user-visible send, and preserving current behavior is an interoperability and product-policy decision not settled by this focused patch.

options.title: Adopt builder truncation
options.body: Keep the Matrix-local first-20 truncation and document it as the channel’s explicit oversized-poll delivery policy.

options.title: Fail before delivery
options.body: Reject oversized Matrix polls with a clear validation error so no requested option is silently omitted.

options.title: Defer enforcement
options.body: Remove the cap and retain current passthrough behavior until maintainers define a Matrix interoperability policy.

recommendation.title: Adopt builder truncation
recommendation.body: Keep the Matrix-local first-20 truncation and document it as the channel’s explicit oversized-poll delivery policy.
